analysis.brief_en: Kinney Drugs has opened seasonal flu vaccination appointments in all its pharmacies across New York and Vermont, offering vaccines to individuals aged 2-64 in New York and 3-64 in Vermont, as well as high-dose vaccines for seniors aged 65+. The 2026-2027 flu vaccine is a trivalent formulation targeting A/H1N1, A/H3N2, and B/Victoria Lineage viruses. The H3N2 component was specifically chosen to address a subclade that was dominant during the 25/26 season. Vaccination is recommended for high-risk groups, including older adults, people with chronic conditions, pregnant individuals, and young children. Appointments can be scheduled online via the Kinney Drugs website or app, with walk-in options also available. The initiative reflects annual vaccine reformulation efforts to match circulating strains, as advised by the WHO. No confirmed outbreak or specific case counts are reported in the supplied evidence.
